Formbricks.PORT: Formbricks listener; Railway's health check calls /health/ready on it.
Formbricks.HOSTNAME: Listen on IPv4 and IPv6 so Railway private networking reaches Formbricks.
Formbricks.WEBAPP_URL: Public Formbricks URL used in links and survey pages. Change it with BETTER_AUTH_URL if you add a custom domain.
Formbricks.BETTER_AUTH_URL: Public Formbricks URL used for authentication and cookies. Keep it equal to WEBAPP_URL.
Formbricks.DATABASE_URL: Private PostgreSQL connection string for the formbricks database.
Formbricks.BETTER_AUTH_SECRET: Generated secret that signs sessions and invite, verification and email-change tokens.
Formbricks.ENCRYPTION_KEY: Generated key for two-factor secrets and single-use survey links. Do not change it after first use.
Formbricks.CRON_SECRET: Generated secret for Formbricks' cron API.
Formbricks.REDIS_URL: Private password-protected Valkey for sessions, rate limits and the background job queue.
Formbricks.HUB_API_KEY: API key of the private Formbricks Hub service.
Formbricks.CUBEJS_API_SECRET: Secret Formbricks signs Cube query tokens with; shared with the Cube service.
Formbricks.CUBEJS_JWT_ISSUER: Issuer claim of Cube query tokens; must match the Cube service.
Formbricks.CUBEJS_JWT_AUDIENCE: Audience claim of Cube query tokens; must match the Cube service.
Formbricks.AUTHZED_SYSTEM_KEY: Name of the Formbricks system object in SpiceDB.
Formbricks.AUTHZED_INSECURE: Plaintext gRPC to SpiceDB over Railway's private network.
Formbricks.AUTHZED_CONSISTENCY: SpiceDB consistency mode for permission checks.
Formbricks.EMAIL_VERIFICATION_DISABLED: No email provider is configured. Set to 0 after adding SMTP variables.
Formbricks.PASSWORD_RESET_DISABLED: No email provider is configured. Set to 0 after adding SMTP variables.
Formbricks.TELEMETRY_DISABLED: Turns off Formbricks' anonymous usage telemetry.
Formbricks.TRUSTED_PROXY_HOP_COUNT: X-Forwarded-For hops Formbricks trusts for the client IP behind Railway's edge; rate limits use it.
Formbricks.FORMBRICKS_OWNER_EMAIL: Required. Your email address. Formbricks creates the owner account for it before its public listener opens, and refuses to start while it is empty.
Formbricks.FORMBRICKS_OWNER_PASSWORD: Generated password of the owner account created at first start. Sign in with it and keep it in a password manager; password reset needs email.

Formbricks Hub.PORT: Hub API listener; Railway's health check calls /health on it.
Formbricks Hub.API_KEY: Generated API key Formbricks uses to call Hub.
Formbricks Hub.DATABASE_URL: Private PostgreSQL connection string; Hub shares the formbricks database.
Formbricks Hub.FORMBRICKS_READY_URL: Private Formbricks readiness URL. Hub waits for Formbricks' migrations before running its own.

Formbricks Hub Worker.DATABASE_URL: Private PostgreSQL connection string; the worker reads Hub's job queue.
Formbricks Hub Worker.HUB_HEALTH_URL: Private Hub health URL. The worker waits for Hub's migrations before starting.

Cube.PORT: Cube API listener; Railway's health check calls /readyz on it.
Cube.CUBEJS_API_SECRET: Generated secret that Cube uses to verify Formbricks' query tokens.
Cube.CUBEJS_JWT_ISSUER: Expected issuer of Formbricks' query tokens.
Cube.CUBEJS_JWT_AUDIENCE: Expected audience of Formbricks' query tokens.
Cube.CUBEJS_EXTERNAL_DEFAULT: No external pre-aggregations, so Cube Store is not needed.
Cube.CUBEJS_CACHE_AND_QUEUE_DRIVER: In-memory cache and queue; keep Cube at one replica.

SpiceDB.PORT: SpiceDB HTTP listener; Railway's health check calls /healthz on it. gRPC stays on 50051.
SpiceDB.SPICEDB_HTTP_ENABLED: Enables SpiceDB's HTTP listener for the health check.
SpiceDB.SPICEDB_DATASTORE_CONN_URI: Private connection string for SpiceDB's own role and database.
SpiceDB.SPICEDB_GRPC_PRESHARED_KEY: Generated key that Formbricks presents to SpiceDB.
SpiceDB.SPICEDB_DATASTORE_CONN_POOL_READ_MAX_OPE: Read connection pool cap, sized for one small PostgreSQL.
SpiceDB.SPICEDB_SKIP_RELEASE_CHECK: Skips SpiceDB's check for newer releases at start.
SpiceDB.SPICEDB_LOG_LEVEL: Warnings and errors only; info logs every gRPC call.

PostgreSQL.SPICEDB_DATABASE_PASSWORD: Generated password of the spicedb role, created with its database when the volume is first initialized.
